title: Axiom of pairing
summary: For any two sets, a set exists whose members are exactly those two sets.

context.note: This node belongs to one explicit foundational presentation; alternate foundations may encode it differently.

assumptions.text: The declared first-order set theory context is fixed.

content.plain: For any two sets, a set exists whose members are exactly those two sets.
content.example: Pairing a with itself yields the singleton {a}.
content.caveat: The axiom guarantees an unordered pair; ordered pairs require an additional encoding.
